activeElements.name: Ambushed

features.name: Relative Strength
features.description: The Difficulty of this environment equals that of the adversary with the highest Difficulty. _Who cues the ambush? What makes it clear they're in charge?_

features.name: Surprise!
features.description: The ambushers reveal themselves to the party, you gain 2 Fear, and the spotlight immediately shifts to one of the ambushing adversaries. _What do the ambushers want from the party? How do their tactics in the ambush reflect that?_

activeElements.description: An ambush is set to catch an unsuspecting party off-guard.

activeElements.name: Ambushers

features.name: Relative Strength
features.description: The Difficulty of this environment equals that of the adversary with the highest Difficulty. _Which adversary is the least prepared? Which one is the most?_

features.name: Where Did They Come From?
features.description: When a PC starts the ambush on unsuspecting adversaries, you lose 2 Fear and the first attack roll a PC makes has advantage. _What are the adversaries in the middle of doing when the ambush starts? How does this impact their approach to the fight?_

activeElements.impulses: Escape, group up, protect the most vulnerable
activeElements.description: An ambush is set by the PCs to catch unsuspecting adversaries off-guard.

activeElements.body:
The first thing to do in this Scene is determine whether the PCs are _Ambushed_ or _Ambushers_, then delete the other Environment from the table.

One way to decide is based on your current Fear. If you are low on Fear, go with _Ambushed_ to regain two. If you need to bleed a little Fear, go with _Ambushers_ to spend two.

Another option is to conduct a Group Roll for the overland travel, and use _Ambushed_ on failure.

For _Ambushed_, have the players place their tokens as though crossing the bridge, then reveal most adversaries except those below the bridge or hidden like the _Shadow_.

For _Ambushers_, reveal the adversaries (except hidden ones), then allow the players to place their tokens.
activeElements.name: Running Crossroads Ambush
Jagged Knife Lieutenant

features.name: Tactician
features.description: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, **mark a Stress** to also spotlight two allies within Close range.

features.name: More Where That Came From
features.description: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.

features.name: Coup de Grace
features.description: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against a _Vulnerable_ target within Close range. On a success, deal **2d6+12** physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

activeElements.description: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.

activeElements.name: Jagged Knife Kneebreaker

features.name: I've Got 'Em
features.description: Creatures _Restrained_ by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

features.name: Hold Them Down
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.

activeElements.description: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.

activeElements.name: Jagged Knife Bandit

features.name: Climber
features.description: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.

features.name: From Above
features.description: When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal **1d10+1** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

activeElements.description: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang's iconic knives.

activeElements.name: Jagged Knife Hexer

features.name: Curse
features.description: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily _Curse_ them. While the target is _Cursed_, you can **mark a Stress** when that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.

features.name: Chaotic Flux
features.description: Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. **Mark a Stress** to deal **2d6+3** magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.

activeElements.description: A staff-wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.

activeElements.name: Jagged Knife Shadow

features.name: Backstab
features.description: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal **1d6+6** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Cloaked
features.description: Become _Hidden_ until after the Shadow's next attack. Attacks made while _Hidden_ from this feature have advantage.

activeElements.description: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.

activeElements.name: Jagged Knife Sniper

features.name: Unseen Strike
features.description: If the Sniper is _Hidden_ when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal **1d10+4** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

activeElements.description: A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow.

activeElements.name: Jagged Knife Lackey

features.name: Minion (3)
features.description: The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Jagged Knife Lackeys within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
